message: Invalid timestamp format "rfc3339". Must be one of: unix-seconds, unix-millis, iso8601. Fern ignores it and falls back to unix-seconds.
x-fern-webhook-signature timestamp must specify a header
x-fern-webhook-signature timestamp tolerance must be a positive number
x-fern-webhook-signature timestamp tolerance must be a positive number; got '300'. fern check does not catch this, but SDK generation fails.
x-fern-webhook-signature timestamp must be an object with a header.
